This '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' was a member of the [[New Jedi Order]]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], she and [[Unidentified Zabrak Jedi trainee|another Jedi]] sparred with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
